I’ve spent three decades watching technology transform recruitment, opening doors to global talent pools and instant connectivity. Yet I remain a firm believer that the basics still matter. Mixing the benefits of social platforms and AI with "old school" personal contact and client/candidate feedback, I help companies secure the best solutions to help drive their talent planning.

My knowledge covers the full talent lifecycle:
- Strategic Growth: Scaling new market entries.
- Tech Integration: Leveraging AI and ATS optimization to drive speed-to-hire and precision.
- Service Evolution: Permanent/Contract recruitment, Outsourcing, Managed (MSP/RPO), and Outplacement Services.
- Global Ops: Navigating the process and legal hurdles of international talent.
- Employer Branding: Understanding the drivers for businesses, ensuring they become the employer of choice.

Feel free to get in touch to exchange ideas and thoughts with me on this - I look forward to interesting new contacts and conversations!
